full_name: David Frankfurter | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2007–2008 Humanities Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow University of New Hampshire
bio: David Frankfurter is a professor of religious studies and history at the University of New Hampshire and a comparative scholar of ancient religions.
